```{r setup,include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Tidyexposomics let's you connect exposures, to phenotypes to omics, which is a lot of ground to cover! We provide a series of tutorials that take you through how to do this. We support exposure-phenotype only workflows and those with omics data included too. 

Got an idea for a tutorial you want? Feel free to submit a request [here](https://github.com/BioNomad/tidyexposomics/issues/new)!
